ai.title: Custom Metal Parts for AI Servers and Data Centers
ai.seo: AI Server & Data Center Metal Parts Manufacturer | Realjet
ai.description: Custom chassis, GPU trays, racks, power shelves and cooling supports for AI servers and data centers. Explore parts and send drawings for a manufacturing quote.
ai.eyebrow: For server OEMs and data-center equipment builders
ai.intro: Source the metal structure for your server or its supporting equipment. Order individual chassis parts, formed supports or welded frames to your drawings, with the mounting interfaces and inspection scope agreed before manufacture.
ai.definition: Choose the part by where it sits in your assembly: inside the GPU server, in the rack and power system, around the liquid-cooling equipment, or in the battery backup cabinet. Each detail page explains the part you can order, its manufacturing route and the fit checks to define.
ai.subhead: Find the part for your AI hardware assembly
ai.buyer: GPU server and chassis OEMs, rack builders, power-equipment manufacturers, CDU integrators and battery-backup cabinet suppliers.
ai.problem: Start with the mating assembly. Tray heights, module slots, rail attachments and service openings need a common set of datums so the finished metalwork fits your equipment.
faqs: Can I order one chassis part rather than a complete server enclosure?

Yes. Identify the bottom shell, panel, tray or bracket in your enquiry and provide its part drawing with the mating assembly. The quotation defines individual parts, joined structures, purchased hardware and delivery condition.
Which components are for the server itself?

Chassis shells, GPU trays, retention brackets and fan cages are server parts. Rack frames, power shelves, CDU structures and battery backup supports belong to the surrounding data-center equipment; each uses its own approved design.
Do cooling support parts include the coolant circuit?

The proposed frame, pump plate and brackets are mechanical supports. Pumps, heat exchangers, manifolds, hoses and coolant are separate unless explicitly included. Pressure, leak and cooling-performance validation have their own scope.
What should I send for an AI equipment component quote?

Send a dimensioned PDF and available STEP, DXF or DWG files, the assembly view, material, finish, quantities and destination. Include module envelopes, interface datums, drawing revision and any fixture or recorded inspection requirements.
Can the first article be checked before repeat orders?

Request a sample or pilot batch with the dimensional report and mating checks you require. Specify who provides the modules or gauges. Scope, timing and repeat-order release are agreed after drawing review.

Deburring, phosphating, powder coating and painting routes are available for review. Mark masked contacts and finished interface requirements; agree dimensional records and mating checks for the first article.

energy.intro: Order the metal parts around your battery modules, power electronics or inverter. REALJET manufactures formed panels and supports, welded cabinet frames and machined mounting features to your approved equipment drawings.
energy.definition: Select components for a battery energy storage system (BESS), power conversion system (PCS), EV DC fast charger or solar PV inverter. The catalogue separates the mechanical parts by equipment so you can review their supply scope, interfaces and inspection requirements.
energy.subhead: Choose parts for the equipment you build
energy.buyer: Battery rack and BESS cabinet builders, PCS manufacturers, EV charging equipment OEMs and inverter mounting-accessory suppliers.
energy.problem: Define the installed loads, module insertion path and cabinet environment early. A tray, frame or bracket needs the correct supports and fixing interfaces before its manufacturing and inspection route can be priced.
faqs: Is a battery module support tray the same as a sealed battery pack housing?

No. The listed tray supports an enclosed module in a rack or cabinet. Sealed pack housings, cell cans and liquid cold plates require separate designs, materials and sealing or pressure-test requirements.
Can I buy only the metal frame for a DC charging cabinet?

Yes. Send the frame and module-bay drawings with the panel and base interfaces. List purchased hardware and delivery condition. Charging electronics, connectors and complete-system qualification are separate unless explicitly agreed.
Can a bracket be made for my solar inverter?
Provide the approved inverter mounting drawing or a dimensioned bracket design. Include the wall-side fixing pattern, hook engagement, device clearance and any specified load or corrosion checks.
Do cabinet parts come with an automatic IP rating?
A frame, panel or door alone does not establish the completed enclosure rating. Specify the full assembly, seals and required test scope if enclosure qualification is part of the order.
What is needed to price a BESS, charging or solar component?

Send the part and assembly drawings, material, finish, quantity, drawing revision and delivery city. Mark support loads, module interfaces, outdoor requirements and the inspection records or mating fixtures needed for acceptance.
